description: This file defines the BaseMigration class for app initialization, handling version storage, keychain repair logic, and migration setup in a Standard Notes-like application.

classes.name: BaseMigration
classes.description: Handles app versioning, keychain repair, and migration registration during app startup.

methods.name: preRun
methods.description: Prepares the migration by storing the app version number.

methods.name: registerStageHandlers
methods.description: Registers handlers for app stages, including keychain repair during launch.

methods.name: getStoredVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the stored app version from raw storage.

methods.name: storeVersionNumber
methods.description: Establishes the app version in storage, inferring from legacy keys if necessary.

methods.name: loadReader
methods.description: Initializes the StorageReader instance based on stored version.

methods.name: needsKeychainRepair
methods.description: Determines if the keychain needs repair based on app state and stored account key params.

methods.name: repairMissingKeychain
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt an item with user-provided password to restore keychain access.
